editor.title: Edit configuration
editor.failed: Validation failed, nothing written to disk
editor.note: Writes must pass validation before apply, so a bad document never reaches disk.
editor.docNote: This is a declarative document: tunnels missing from the list get deleted. Format: {"version":1,"tunnels":[…]}.
editor.deleteWarning: The {{count}} tunnel(s) below are not in the document and will be deleted on apply. This cannot be undone.
editor.nothingToDo: The document already matches the current configuration; applying it changes nothing.
editor.confirmBody: A declarative import deletes tunnels missing from the document: {{slugs}}. This cannot be undone.
editor.partial: Only partially applied ({{applied}} written). The document describes the desired end state, so re-running it is safe.
editor.savedNotRunning: Configuration saved, but the runtime did not come up.

password.title: Change password
password.mustRotate: This is the first sign-in; the password must be rotated.
